name: Logging
description: Structured logging setup with rotation and request IDs
template_code:
import logging
import sys
from uuid import uuid4

from loguru import logger

def setup_logging(service_name: str = 'app'):
    logger.remove()
    logger.add(
        sys.stderr,
        format='{time:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS} | {level:7} | {extra[request_id]:36} | {message}',
        level='INFO',
    )
    logger.add(
        f'logs/{service_name}.log',
        rotation='10 MB',
        retention='30 days',
        format='{time:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS} | {level:7} | {extra[request_id]:36} | {message}',
    )
    logger = logger.bind(request_id=str(uuid4()))
    return logger
best_practices: Rotate logs to manage disk usage
